cases.prompt: Design a greenfield lifecycle email program for our new SaaS product; no campaigns or provider integration exist yet.
cases.rationale: With no implemented system to verify, the work should start at future-state strategy.

cases.prompt: Implement the unchanged approved lifecycle email strategy, including events, templates, provider configuration, and tests.
cases.rationale: Current-state audit and strategy approval are complete; execution belongs to Goalpro.

cases.prompt: Design our post-signup lifecycle email strategy around first value, repeated value, adoption, inactivity, and respectful win-back, then let me approve an interactive preview before implementation.
cases.rationale: The deliverable is an approval-ready behavior-driven lifecycle program rather than current-state diagnosis or open-ended ideation.

cases.prompt: Use agent-work/customer-progress/email-lifecycle-audit/STRATEGY-INPUT.md to compare replacement lifecycle programs that preserve strengths and resolve the EML findings.
cases.rationale: A completed audit handoff now needs future program choices, humanized messages, and named preview approval.

cases.prompt: Create onboarding, activation rescue, feature adoption, 30/60/90-day re-engagement, and sunset email strategy with behavioral exits, global suppression, consent, deliverability, holdouts, and product-specific copy; do not implement it.
cases.rationale: This is a complete read-only lifecycle strategy with product, campaign, trust, copy, and measurement ownership.

cases.prompt: Only audit our existing lifecycle campaigns and tell us what is currently broken; do not propose a replacement yet.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly requests current-state diagnosis without future strategy.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this one welcome email in our product voice while preserving its existing trigger, audience, CTA, and template variables.
cases.rationale: A bounded copy rewrite does not require lifecycle-state or portfolio strategy.

cases.prompt: Audit our implemented signup and first-run experience, trace the path to activation, and report the highest-confidence friction without changing source.
cases.rationale: An existing onboarding system needs specialized read-only journey and activation diagnosis before any replacement direction.

cases.prompt: Assess our native mobile onboarding for launch speed, one-handed use, keyboard behavior, contextual permissions, offline recovery, accessibility, and first value.
cases.rationale: The request is a systemic evidence-backed audit of implemented mobile onboarding rather than future design.

cases.prompt: Audit and improve the existing web and mobile onboarding; preserve what works, create a report, then feed it into a new onboarding direction.
cases.rationale: Audit-and-improve begins with the implemented-state audit, which then hands the same slug to Onboarding Direction.

cases.prompt: Design onboarding for a greenfield mobile app and show me several clickable activation flows before implementation.
cases.rationale: No implemented journey exists to audit; the task is approval-first future onboarding direction.

cases.prompt: Only rewrite the labels, errors, permission explanations, and success messages in this existing onboarding without changing the flow.
cases.rationale: This is a bounded copy-only fidelity task, not a systemic onboarding audit.

cases.prompt: Design optimized onboarding for our new web and mobile product, compare three genuinely different activation paths, and let me approve a clickable preview before implementation.
cases.rationale: The specialized deliverable is an approval-ready cross-platform onboarding system rather than general visual direction or open-ended ideation.

cases.prompt: Use agent-work/first-value/onboarding-audit/DIRECTION-INPUT.md to create a new direction that fixes the verified findings while preserving the current strengths.
cases.rationale: A completed audit handoff now needs distinct replacement concepts and explicit preview approval.

cases.prompt: Redesign our first-run journey around faster activation, contextual permissions, realistic in-product copy, interruption recovery, and measurable user success; do not implement it yet.
cases.rationale: This is pre-implementation onboarding direction with platform, copy, resilience, and measurement ownership.

cases.prompt: Audit the onboarding already in production and tell us where users encounter friction, but do not propose a replacement yet.
cases.rationale: The user requests current-state diagnosis only.

cases.prompt: Plan the implementation of our already-approved onboarding blueprint against this repository's real routes, state, analytics, auth, tests, and rollout system.
cases.rationale: Direction is approved; repository-grounded implementation planning now belongs to Planpro.
